_comment: Keys go through type-modelled exports that hand back what they were given (Option.some then Option.getOrThrow, Tuple.make then index 0), and the program looks services up through the results. A key effect's code returns may be one it was handed, so each lookup reaches its service's implementation and the method read through it stays. Keys handed to type-modelled code also bail today, so the unread methods are not asserted; Other, looked up directly, prunes.
